aegisOperational.description: Readable Fleet work light: Ion White task illumination, deep-blue structural surfaces and restrained warm practical accents. Faces, controls, tools and physical routes through the ship remain clear.

rescueEmergency.description: Emergency lighting supplements rather than obscures the scene: localized amber and red status signals, portable work lamps, suit lamps and harsh compartment lights while critical faces and repair geometry remain readable.

convoyExterior.description: Naturalistic space exposure with readable hull silhouettes, engine light, navigation markers and corridor infrastructure. Avoid decorative nebula glow unless the location explicitly requires it.

medicalOverflow.description: Bright clinical task light adapted to temporary spaces, with portable lamps and marked treatment zones rather than stylized hospital darkness.
